comment: Anankos Sim Lab v1 - focused MITRE ATT&CK for ICS technique library. SIMULATION ONLY: every effect mutates in-memory simulated device state. No real protocols, devices, or networks are touched.

techniques.name: Default Credentials
techniques.description: Authenticate to an engineering/management interface using factory-default credentials to gain control of a facility's control network.

techniques.name: Exploitation of Remote Services
techniques.description: Exploit an exposed remote service (e.g. an internet-reachable VPN or RDP jump host) to pivot onto the OT network of a facility.

techniques.name: Modify Parameter
techniques.description: Change a device setpoint or configuration parameter (e.g. turbine output setpoint, chemical dose, pump speed) to drive the process out of its safe band.

techniques.name: Unauthorized Command Message
techniques.description: Issue an unauthorized control command to an actuator (e.g. open a breaker, stop a pump, force a transfer switch).

techniques.name: Manipulation of Control
techniques.description: Take direct control of a process actuator, overriding normal automatic regulation.

techniques.name: Manipulate I/O Image
techniques.description: Alter the I/O image the controller reads so logic acts on falsified field values while the physical process diverges.

techniques.name: Spoof Reporting Message
techniques.description: Falsify the value reported to the operator HMI so the control room sees normal readings while the real process value is different.

techniques.name: Denial of Service
techniques.description: Flood or crash a device's communications so it can no longer respond to commands or protective logic (e.g. blind a transfer switch or safety controller).

techniques.name: Device Restart/Shutdown
techniques.description: Force a controller or actuator to restart or shut down, dropping the process it governs.

techniques.name: Loss of Safety
techniques.description: Defeat or disable a safety instrumented function so the process can reach an unsafe state without protective intervention.
